title: When the Cover Wakes
author: Rafael Galloway
blurb: Freya Nakamura, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
